clue.text: The laughter raised by William Joyce

definitions.meaning: a loud affected guffaw, a 'haw' sound repeated
the Nazi propaganda broadcaster nicknamed Lord ... for his drawling voice

explanation.surface: A wartime broadcaster provokes a laugh.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both an imitation of a mocking guffaw and the nickname given to the traitor broadcaster Joyce.

clue.text: Dance to the accompaniment of two instruments

parts.note: a horn is a brass instrument
a pipe is a wind instrument

explanation.surface: A dancer performs while two musicians play.
explanation.definitionFit: A hornpipe is a lively solo dance traditionally associated with sailors.

clue.text: Fine spring-what a surprise!

parts.note: well means healthy or fine
a well is a spring of water

explanation.surface: Someone is astonished to find fine weather in spring.
explanation.definitionFit: The doubled exclamation is said when something unexpected turns up.

clue.text: Like to consume the French drinks

indicators.note: to consume means to take something inside, so one piece goes into the other

parts.note: as means like
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Someone is fond of drinking French beverages.
explanation.definitionFit: Ales are beers, a common kind of drink.

clue.text: In the main they are responsible for getting fish aboard

definitions.text: In the main they are responsible for getting fish aboard

parts.words: In the main they are responsible for getting fish aboard
parts.note: 'the main' is the sea, and those in charge of fishing boats are their captains; the fish themselves also share the name

explanation.surface: Fishing-boat masters see that the catch is landed on deck.
explanation.definitionFit: A skipper is the captain of a small vessel such as a trawler, and also a name for a kind of fish.

clue.text: Considerable attention given to the competitive money-lender

definitions.meaning: eager attention or absorption in something
a lender who competes offers attractive, sharply priced rates of charge on loans

explanation.surface: A rival lender attracts lots of notice.
explanation.definitionFit: Strong curiosity, and also the sharp loan rate a competing lender offers; 'keen' means low-priced in British usage.

clue.text: Daddy and I had no debt outstanding

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
I'd is the contraction of I had

explanation.surface: Father and I cleared what we owed.
explanation.definitionFit: A bill that is settled leaves nothing owing.

clue.text: Followed Susan in the finish

indicators.note: in means one piece goes inside the other here

parts.note: the end is the finish
Sue is short for Susan

explanation.surface: Susan came behind at the end of a race.
explanation.definitionFit: Ensued means came after, resulted.

clue.text: Do its ups and downs provide a present and past view?

definitions.text: Do its ups and downs provide a present and past view?

parts.words: Do its ups and downs provide a present and past view?
parts.note: a playground plank that goes up and down, its two halves read as the present and past tenses of the verb meaning to view

explanation.surface: A rider on a playground plank wonders whether going up and down shows now and then.
explanation.walkthrough: The present tense of 'view' is SEE and its past tense SAW, so the name of the up-and-down plank is a present then past view.
explanation.definitionFit: A seesaw is a balanced plank on which children ride alternately up and down.

clue.text: The wave that may produce a permanent wave

definitions.meaning: a long heavy wave rolling in from the sea

definitions.text: that may produce a permanent wave
definitions.meaning: a curler used to set hair in waves

explanation.surface: A big breaker could give one a perm.
explanation.definitionFit: It names both a long swelling sea wave and a hair curler used for setting waves.

clue.text: Flotation is the current subject for discussion

definitions.meaning: the launch of shares on the stock market

explanation.surface: A stock-market launch is the talk of the day.
explanation.definitionFit: Shares put on sale for the first time, and also a fresh matter now under debate.

clue.text: Enduring grievance, perhaps, of the non-sedentary worker-

definitions.text: grievance, perhaps, of the non-sedentary worker
definitions.meaning: a worker who never sits might complain of being on their feet for hours

explanation.surface: A worker who never sits has a lasting complaint.
explanation.definitionFit: Long-established and durable, and also a description of hours spent on one's feet.

clue.text: Pop is a puppet

definitions.meaning: to pop something is slang for leaving it with a pawnbroker
someone used by others, like the least chess piece

explanation.surface: Father is someone else's stooge.
explanation.definitionFit: To pop means to hock at a pawnbroker's, and a person manipulated by others is a tool or stooge.

clue.text: Reason to record one century

parts.note: to log is to record
I is the Roman numeral one
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: A motive for trying to score a hundred.
explanation.definitionFit: Logic is sound reasoning.

clue.text: Male Egyptian deity in the Greek pantheon

parts.note: he is the male pronoun
Ra is the Egyptian sun god

explanation.surface: An Egyptian god turns up among the Greek gods.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a loose phrase for a figure found in the Greek pantheon; the answer is the queen of the Olympian gods.
explanation.definitionFit: She was the wife of Zeus and chief goddess of the Olympians.

clue.text: Neat and direct

definitions.meaning: neat is an old word for cattle, here a young castrated bull
to guide or control a course

explanation.surface: Tidy and straightforward.
explanation.definitionFit: A bullock, from 'neat' meaning cattle, and a verb meaning to guide.

clue.text: What sitting members once stood for

definitions.text: What sitting members once stood for

parts.words: What sitting members once stood for
parts.note: sitting MPs earlier stood as candidates for places in Parliament, and things to sit on are what members sit on

explanation.surface: Current MPs once stood as candidates for something.
explanation.definitionFit: Places in Parliament are contested at elections, and chairs are things one sits on.

clue.text: Apply force to win the lady-but dose in unison

parts.note: to pull is to apply force
to get is to win
her refers to a woman

explanation.surface: A suitor tries to drag a woman along but should cooperate.
explanation.definitionFit: To pull together is to cooperate, all working in concert.

clue.text: Needs rig-out from a couturier

indicators.note: out signals the letters are thrown out of order

explanation.surface: A fashion house supplies the outfit one requires.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rig-out' (an outfit) hides the anagram signal 'out' attached to the fodder RIG.
explanation.definitionFit: A couturier creates fashionable clothes.

clue.text: Commence career as a celebrated racing-spy

parts.note: star means famous
a tout spies on racehorses in training to sell tips

explanation.surface: Someone begins working life as a famous tipster at the races.
explanation.definitionFit: To start out is to begin one's career or journey.

clue.text: Withdraw to a place to meditate?

definitions.meaning: a retreat is a quiet place for meditation, and to beat a path somewhere is to hurry there

explanation.surface: Going off to a quiet place to think.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to retire hastily, and read literally it is hurrying to a quiet refuge.

clue.text: Frank admission that one has ability and has used it

parts.note: can means is able
did means carried it out

explanation.surface: Someone honestly admits they were able and did it.
explanation.definitionFit: Candid means honest and outspoken.

clue.text: Muddle through like a Dickensian beadle

definitions.meaning: The pompous parish beadle in Oliver Twist

explanation.surface: Getting by somehow like an officious parish officer.
explanation.definitionFit: To act clumsily or blunder, and the name of the beadle in Dickens's Oliver Twist.

clue.text: Border on a reservation

parts.note: a but is an objection or reservation

explanation.surface: Land adjoining a reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: To abut is to adjoin or touch at an edge.

clue.text: Gangster hides a feeling of remorse

indicators.note: hides means the letters sit concealed inside the word Gangster

explanation.surface: A mobster conceals his guilt.
explanation.definitionFit: Angst is anxiety or inner torment.

clue.text: He draws level

parts.note: a person who ties a match, or a level or row

explanation.surface: A competitor equalises.
explanation.definitionFit: One who ties draws the contest, and a layer or rank is a level.

clue.text: Appeal to the student body to show responsibility

parts.note: O is an exclamation of appeal, as in 'O Lord'
NUS is the National Union of Students

explanation.surface: Students are urged to act responsibly.
explanation.definitionFit: The onus is the burden or duty.

clue.text: Invariably the centre-piece of a diva's 'performance

indicators.note: the centre-piece means only the middle letters of the word are taken

explanation.surface: A diva's show always has a central highlight.
explanation.definitionFit: An aria is a solo song sung in opera.

clue.text: Carefree description of the exultant socialite

parts.note: a deb is a debutante, a young society girl
on air, as in walking on air, means elated

explanation.surface: A society girl is happy-go-lucky.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'description' is a deb who is on air, as in 'walking on air'.
explanation.definitionFit: Debonair means suave and light-hearted.

clue.text: Spanish-American makes a broad smile disappear

parts.note: a grin is a broad smile
to go is to disappear

explanation.surface: A Latin American wipes off a wide smile.
explanation.definitionFit: In Spanish-speaking America, gringo is the word for a foreigner, especially an English speaker.

clue.text: Formal riding habit to wear out

parts.note: a habit is a style of dress, as in a riding habit
to age is to wear out

explanation.surface: Riding clothes are worn until threadbare.
explanation.definitionFit: Dressage is the training of a horse in precise formal movements.

clue.text: Root cause of vehicle depreciation?

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
rot means decay or decline

explanation.surface: Is rust the underlying reason cars lose value?
explanation.definitionFit: A carrot is a root vegetable.
